lead: The speaker is attempting to jump and is being encouraged to do so.
summaryOneLine: The speaker is attempting to jump and is being encouraged to do so.
articleBodyHtml:
Claim 1

The speaker is attempting to jump and is being encouraged to do so.

Claim 2

The speaker is confirming something and there is no problem.

Claim 3

The speaker is doing a stream and mentions their fridge.

Claim 4

Some people are good at talking to chat.

Claim 5

The team is experiencing difficulties and has been working for 20 minutes.

Claim 6

The game crashed and the speaker is experiencing anxiety.

Claim 7

The speaker previously drew themselves like a dog.

Claim 8

The speaker is trying chamomile and continues talking.

Claim 9

The speaker expresses envy and questions the listener's self-management.

Claim 10

People are diverse and it's important to enjoy life.

Claim 11

A secret is being discussed.

Claim 12

There are stairs here.

Claim 13

Someone enjoys the atmosphere of Butler Cafe and asks if the speaker has been there.

Claim 14

They acknowledge a real-world scenario.

Claim 15

Characters are attempting a task and encountering difficulties.

Claim 16

Someone expressed dissatisfaction with an image.

Claim 17

They are planning to jump repeatedly.

Claim 18

They are attempting to hit the laser again.

Claim 19

People are reacting.

Claim 20

I see.

Claim 21

They believe they have mastered the timing.

Claim 22

The speaker didn't check the time.

Claim 23

Participants are considering skipping a section of the route.

Claim 24

Someone wants to know something and asks for a hold.

Claim 25

An exclamation of surprise or frustration.

Claim 26

Viewers are encouraged to check the VOD.
